dedupe_keys.name: epigrids western network 20 758 bus synthetic grid on the footprint of the western united states

description: Texas A&M University distributes the EPIGRIDS synthetic electricity-network model for the western United States. The case has 20,758 buses and represents transmission at 500, 230, 138 and 69 kV. Its load allocation broadly follows population patterns. The provider attributes network construction to Snodgrass’s 2021 methods and the ARPA-E GRID DATA project. The model supports network power-flow studies, but its lines are synthetic and do not represent actual assets. The page links a case download through Google Drive. Texas A&M permits free commercial and non-commercial use under custom terms and encourages citation. Specific file formats, temporal assumptions and archive contents were not inspected. The case belongs to the Electric Grid Test Case Repository. Metadata was read through a cached provider web view; direct HTTP access returned 403. No model files were downloaded. Related resources are linked through the parent catalogue. Download contents remain unverified.
